en.askTitle: Put in your own salary, move date and visa to get the same arrival budget, rentals and runway check
en.runTitle: A couple moving to Melbourne in March 2027 on one AUD 95,000 salary while the partner looks for work

fields.label: Salary, and whether super is added or included
First payday
fields.placeholder: e.g. two weeks after starting work, 17 March 2027

fields.label: Partner’s confirmed net income
fields.value: None yet; my partner will look for work after we arrive

fields.label: Visa, tax residency and health cover
Office location and start time
fields.value: The Melbourne CBD, a 1- or 2-bedroom place within 35 minutes by public transport

en.template: Plan our move to {city} on {move_date} for {household}, {car}, salary {salary}, first payday {first_payday} and confirmed partner net income {partner}. Use our {visa}. Show monthly costs using weekly × 52 ÷ 12, actual lease charges, take-home pay, private-cover and super-inclusive alternatives. Compare {listings} dated rentals near {office} and actual door-to-office trips. Separate bond, prepaid rent, setup, pre-payday living and emergency reserves; check delayed pay without double-counting. Give an editable budget and summary with dated sources, estimates and unknowns. Do not contact anyone, apply, book, pay or publish.

phases.title: Read official tax, visa, health and transport rules, plus current rental listings
phases.note: Tax rates, fares, bond rules and dated listings
phases.judgment: It spotted that today’s Melbourne fares are temporarily discounted until 1 January 2027, so it did not build a March 2027 budget on them. It budgeted an undiscounted baseline of $420–500 a month for two frequent travellers instead.

phases.title: Build the editable monthly budget, arrival costs and one-income runway scenarios
phases.note: Take-home pay, rent, bills, arrival cash and reserves
phases.judgment: Because the visa subclass wasn’t known, it flagged a real conflict: Melbourne counts as non-regional, but the 491 and 494 visa conditions require living and working in designated regional areas, so a CBD budget can’t simply apply to those visas.

phases.title: Create and verify the spreadsheet and the phone-friendly page
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer caught an overstatement: the commute times were described as including the office walk, but they actually end at the CBD station exit, so the wording was corrected.

workers: Found and read current rental listings in three suburbs, with weekly rent, bedrooms, nearest station and the train time to the CBD
Checked the official public transport fares and Victoria’s rules on bond and rent, then utilities, internet, phone and grocery costs
Checked the official tax, super and health rules for the arrival scenarios, including part-year tax and Medicare
Independently reviewed the finished budget workbook, recomputing totals and checking the arrival and runway sums for double-counting

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的薪资、搬家日期和签证，就能得到同样的落地预算、房源和单薪撑多久核对
zh.runTitle: 一对伴侣 2027 年 3 月搬到墨尔本：一份 9.5 万澳元的年薪，伴侣还在找工作

fields.label: 工资金额，另加或已含退休金
首薪日
fields.placeholder: 例如：上班后两周，2027 年 3 月 17 日

fields.label: 伴侣已确认的净收入
fields.value: 暂时没有，伴侣到了以后再找工作

fields.label: 签证、税务居民和医疗资格
办公室位置和上班时间
fields.value: 墨尔本市中心，公共交通 35 分钟内的一居或两居

zh.template: 请帮我们规划{city}、{move_date}的落地预算：家庭{household}、{car}，工资{salary}，首薪日{first_payday}，伴侣已确认净收入{partner}，签证、税务居民事实和医疗资格{visa}。月预算用周额 × 52 ÷ 12，但另核对租约实际收费；比较私人医保和含退休金薪资情景。找{listings}条{office}附近带日期房源，实查门到办公室通勤。分开押金、预付房租、安顿费、首薪前生活和应急储备，检查发薪延迟且不重复计入。给可编辑预算和摘要，写明来源日期、估算及未知项；不要联系、申请、预订、付款或发布。

phases.title: 阅读官方税务、签证、医保和交通规定，以及当前在租房源
phases.note: 税率、票价、押金规定和有日期的房源
phases.judgment: 它注意到墨尔本现在的票价到 2027 年 1 月 1 日前是临时折扣，所以没有拿它来做 2027 年 3 月的预算，改用不打折的基准：两个人经常出行，每月约 420–500 澳元。

phases.title: 做可编辑的月度预算、落地费用和单薪撑多久的情景
phases.note: 税后收入、房租、账单、落地现金和储备
phases.judgment: 签证子类别未知，所以它标出一处真实冲突：墨尔本不算偏远地区，而 491 和 494 签证的条件要求在指定偏远地区居住和工作，市中心的预算不能直接套用在这两类签证上。

phases.title: 生成并核对电子表格和手机友好页面
phases.judgment: 独立复核同事抓到一处夸大：通勤时间被说成包含走到办公室的路程，实际只到市中心车站出口，措辞随后做了修正。

workers: 在三个郊区找到并读了在租房源，记下周租、卧室数、最近车站和到市中心的列车时间
查了官方公共交通票价和维多利亚州的押金、租金规定，再查水电、网络、手机和食品开销
查了官方税务、退休金和医保规定，覆盖落地后几种情景，包括当年部分年度税和医保税
独立审查做好的预算工作簿，重新算合计，并检查落地现金和撑多久的计算有没有重复计入
